description: Separate Windows RTX 3080 10 GiB Qwen IQ2_XS text cohort: 16 capacities, MTP off and embedded MTP3.

source.note: The measurements predate the later sweep-script bandwidth/Windows fixes. Curves use the recorded timings; exporting documentation is not a new measurement.

protocol.measurement_count: One retained full-workload measurement per context/mode; no repeated-trial confidence interval.
protocol.off_128k_origin: Reused the successful full-workload 128K maximum-arena probe, which uses the same 256-token/4-output warmup and full prompt/decode protocol as the ordinary sweep.

arenas.policy: Fit at 128K separately for each mode, then hold fixed across its sweep; no arbitrary reserve.

streaming_first_sampled_decode_context.note: Sampled in 8 Ki steps; these are not exact crossover thresholds or intrinsic model limits.

driver_policy.name: Prefer No Sysmem Fallback
driver_policy.evidence: User confirmed applying the per-executable setting; server restarted for probes.
driver_policy.note: Shared GPU-memory counters include mapped host KV RAM and do not independently prove residency of every device allocation.

scope.tested: Text-only target and embedded MTP3 through 131072 configured positions.
scope.comparison: Mode-specific fixed arenas, not equal-arena isolation or a Windows-vs-Linux comparison.
scope.output_note: Input prompts and output lengths match; generated continuations differed in 15 of 16 pairs. This is an observed throughput comparison, not an identical-output isolation experiment.
scope.quality_note: This throughput cohort does not establish numerical equivalence or model quality.

artifacts.path_normalization: Machine-local server/model/corpus paths replaced with placeholders or repository paths; timing values and token IDs retained.
artifacts.export_line_endings: UTF-8 text with LF, pinned by repository .gitattributes; recorded producer/log hashes are retained separately.

h2d_note: Historical h2d_util_pct used an uncalibrated 50 GB/s reference. Raw records retain it for provenance; the published throughput chart and comparison CSV do not use it as measured PCIe utilization.
